name: Kimi wa Ore no Mono 2
source:
The protagonist is now devoted to her work instead of love. She was on good terms with the handsome store manager and the deputy store manager, and would go to a coffee shop after work or whenever something happened. Everyone respects her idea of ​​''I want to do my best for myself rather than love now,'' and the she is happy because she feels a sense of fulfillment for the first time in her life. But then... who came to the main character!?

[Edited from the [url=https://apps.apple.com/ng/app/id1659173818]App Store[/url]]
